usedFor: Shopify holds orders, and DataScope assigns a form task through “Assign New Task” after an “Order Cancelled”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Assign New Task” in DataScope
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation creates a task tied to a form and a person, so a follow-up check happens.

watchOut: “Assign New Task” needs a specific form and user, so choose both before any “Order Cancelled” runs.
